title: C4.1.5 coding band: R25 and below

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

verified.note: Helper table; band 'R25 and below' as printed in C4.1.5.

notes: Engine helper, not a published table: true where the clause's coding band applies, false otherwise (default false). Used as a condition inside the concession exceptions on C4.1.1, C4.1.1-r1 and C4.1.1-r4 (a table-lookup with no fact answers MEETS when the value is truthy), because exceptions cannot carry a coding of their own. Values are never null so a composite condition cannot pass on NOT_APPLICABLE. C4.1.5: small dwelling (C2.9.1) at R25 and below.
